verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only porting a number IN to Community Phone: free transfers, a dedicated rep, and the customer supplying the PIN, account number and LOA from their old carrier. Nothing documents porting a number OUT, port-out fees, or the app exposing an account number or port-out PIN for a gaining carrier; the app is described only as managing line, calls and voicemail. The 'no contract, cancel anytime' claim is adjacent and does not establish a documented port-out capability.
